trend.colors.title: Colors
trend.colors.subtitle: This season's palette is shaped around earthy tones, soft lavender, and deep burgundy.
trend.color.burgundyDesc: The essential winter tone, in blazers and bags.
trend.color.oliveDesc: Natural and sophisticated. Stands out in jackets and trousers.
trend.color.lavenderDesc: Soft and feminine. In sweaters and accessories.
trend.color.camelDesc: Timeless classic. In coats and trench coats.
trend.color.pebbleGrayDesc: The new face of minimalism. Pairs with everything.
trend.color.chocolateDesc: Warm and luxurious. In leather pieces and boots.
trend.pieces.title: Pieces
trend.pieces.subtitle: Layering is this season's main theme. Effortless yet intentional outfits.
trend.piece.oversizedBlazerDesc: The star piece of the season. Wear over a dress or with a tee. Dropped shoulders are key.
trend.piece.poloSweaterDesc: Opt for cashmere or merino wool. Wear alone or layer over a shirt.
trend.piece.pencilSkirtDesc: Reimagined with bold fabrics and colors. Leather and satin versions are trending.
trend.piece.leatherPiecesDesc: Beyond black: tan, gray, olive green. In skirts, trousers, and jackets.
trend.piece.croppedJacketDesc: Creates a modern set with high-waist trousers or skirts.
trend.piece.miniDressDesc: An iconic combo with knee-high boots. Knit and satin fabrics are the go-to.
trend.shoes.title: Shoes
trend.shoes.subtitle: Boots are stealing the spotlight this winter. Boot season is officially open.
trend.shoe.cowboyBootsDesc: A rebellious touch to city style. Looks amazing with dresses and skirts.
trend.shoe.slouchyBootsDesc: Relaxed and cool. Pair with skinny jeans or mini skirts.
trend.shoe.balletFlatsDesc: V-cut details in various textures. From office to dinner.
trend.shoe.kneeHighBootsDesc: A legendary duo with mini dresses. Suede and leather versions.
trend.accessories.title: Accessories
trend.accessories.subtitle: Small finishing touches make a big difference in completing your outfit.
trend.accessory.chunkyScarfDesc: Oversized, draped. Opt for camel hair or wool.
trend.accessory.goldJewelryDesc: Layered necklaces, chunky bracelets. Minimalist yet eye-catching.
trend.accessory.structuredBagDesc: Box-shaped, clean lines. In burgundy and chocolate tones.
